mapper.insert: insert into personal_rank(rank_name, user_id, category_id, target_id) VALUES (#{rankName},#{userId},#{categoryId},#{targetId})

insert into rank_song(rank_id, song_id, ranking) VALUES
(#{item.rankId},#{item.songId},#{item.ranking})
insert into comment(rank_id, user_id, parent_id, comment_content,comment_time,id_delete) VALUES (#{rankId},#{userId}, NULL #{parentId} ,#{content},now(),0)
mapper.select: select singer_id,singer_name from singer where category_id=#{categoryId} and singer_status=1
select song.song_id,song.song_name from song where singer_id=#{singerId} and song_status=1

select a.rank_id,a.rank_name,a.publish_time,a.user_id,0 as vote_count,0 as love_count, b.rs_id,b.song_id,b.ranking,b.rank_update_time,c.song_name,d.singer_name from (select p.rank_id,p.rank_name,p.publish_time,p.user_id from personal_rank as p where p.category_id=#{category} order by publish_time asc limit #{pageSize} offset #{offset}) a left join rank_song as b on a.rank_id = b.rank_id left join song as c on c.song_id=b.song_id left join singer as d on c.singer_id = d.singer_id order by b.rank_update_time asc, b.ranking asc

select count(distinct p.rank_id) from personal_rank as p left join rank_song as r on p.rank_id = r.rank_id left join song as s on s.song_id=r.song_id left join singer as si on s.singer_id = si.singer_id where p.category_id=#{category} and (s.song_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or si.singer_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or p.rank_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')) order by p.publish_time asc,r.ranking desc

select distinct c.com_id,c.rank_id,c.user_id,c.parent_id,pc.user_id as parent_user_id, c.comment_content,c.comment_time,0 as like_count,0 as is_liked from comment as c left join comment pc on pc.com_id=c.parent_id where c.rank_id=#{rankId} and c.id_delete=0 order by c.comment_time desc limit 50
